_doc: Gate D: dispersive Lorentz ADE + subpixel (CMT-like) averaging of planar layers. docs/DISPERSION_SUBPIXEL.md. Separate from the frozen thresholds_nu.json (untouched).
_status: APPROVED by the user 2026-11-05 (user decision; frozen, sha256 recorded in CLAUDE.md). amendments _amend_t_end (100 -> 300 T0) and D2-1 _amend (order fit over nl = 160..640) approved as part of this decision. History: PROPOSED 2026-11-04 -- written by Claude after diagnostic runs (Si3N4/Si ARC: FDTD vs exact lattice <= 4.5e-7; subpixel order 2.04; thickness sweep); awaiting the user's decision before it is frozen.

structures.B: GaAs 50 nm on SiO2 (absorbing film, transparent substrate: R, T)
structures.C: (SiO2 103 nm / Si3N4 73.5 nm) x 3 on Si (quarter-wave stack at 600 nm)

common.materials: materials/models.json (Lorentz fits of Green 2008 Si, Malitson SiO2, Luke Si3N4, Aspnes GaAs over 400-800 nm)
common.theory_discrete: disp_tmm.lattice_rt: exact Yee lattice with the ADE eps_fd(w), subpixel/staircase weights
common.theory_continuous: disp_tmm.stack_cont: continuous TMM with the fitted model (or the raw data)
common._amend_t_end: was 100 T0; D1-1 B failed (1.45e-4) from DFT truncation of the near-lossless GaAs 353 nm pole ringing (300 T0: <= 6.3e-7). results/nu_failures.json. Approved by the user 2026-11-05.

D0-1.what: non-dispersive stack (eps 2.25 half-space on a primal node) vs legacy eps2/y1, fields after 600 steps

D1-1.what: FDTD vs exact lattice, A/B/C, s and p, subpixel; A also staircase: max over band |R - R_lat|

D1-2.what: same, structure B: max over band |T - T_lat|

D2-1.what: subpixel convergence order of RMS_band |R - R_cont(model)| (structure A, s, nl listed)
D2-1._amend: was nl = 80..320 (order 1.45, FAIL): nl=80 (Si 9.5 pts/lambda at 400 nm) is pre-asymptotic; every 5-point window from nl >= 113 gives 2.13-2.24, offset-averaged 2.14. results/nu_failures.json. Approved by the user 2026-11-05.

D3.what: thickness sweep of A (Si3N4 48-102 nm, 2.5 nm steps) at fixed Delta = 15 nm (nl=40) and 7.5 nm: max |R - R_cont| subpixel vs staircase at f = 1 (600 nm)

D4.what: mesh needed by staircase to match subpixel accuracy (Lumerical CMT claim analog: CMT at 10 ppw ~ staircase at 34 ppw)

D5.what: material fit quality (RMS rel eps error) and its effect on R: TMM(model) vs TMM(raw data)
